changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 4b item 2: moved TeamStore onto a per-Team TransactionalStore, replacing its exclusive-write-plus-readback create path with a load-decide-write inside the store's own serialized queue and its manual write queue with the store's tail. TeamService now holds its Team's TransactionalStore handle directly instead of a caller-refreshed record field, and the Team read model answers leader_state from a live TeamService's own in-memory identity before falling back to a one-shot file read. record.json's shape, TeamStore's/TeamService's public methods, and Command/MCP-visible behavior are unchanged; only the anti-resurrection mechanism moved from 'merge against disk' to 'one in-memory owner per Team, merging against its committed value' (already an accepted operator ruling, 2026-09-19).
